description: Clean a CSV at csvPath and upload it as a matched-audience DMP segment. Auto-detects contact (email) vs company (account) lists, normalizes column names, drops non-matcher columns, hashes emails, and converts company domains to website URLs. Requires the Audiences product; matching takes up to 48h.

csvPath.description: Path to the CSV file on the server

type.description: Force the list type; auto-detected if omitted

name: upload_audience_csv
